To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the power consumption of the DSP processor is the main contributor to the total power consumption of the system, and that the data mapping has a great influence on the power consumption of a processor.
the energy consumption of a program depends on the algorithm and the data mapping.

the power and energy consumptions of a processor are highly influenced by the data mapping, that it is possible to estimate and optimize the energy consumption of a program at the algorithmic level using a tool like SoftExplorer, and that the energy efficiency of a processor is not the same as its energy consumption.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: how to estimate and analyze power and energy consumption at the algorithmic level, and how to use this analysis to optimize the consumption of the application.
the development of a tool to analyze the power and the energy consumption of an application at the algorithmic level.
the development of tools to help the designer to estimate and analyze his application at the algorithmic level.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SoftExplorer is a tool that allows us to characterize the consumption and the influence of each loop in the algorithm and to estimate the consumption of the algorithm in a specific processor.

SoftExplorer is a tool for the algorithmic level power/energy estimation of a C program, and that the user can choose the model of processor and the operating frequency, and that it can be used to find the optimal data mapping for a VLIW DSP application.
the tool is useful and efficient for the analysis, optimization, and comparison of the power and energy of an algorithm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a tool for estimating the power and energy of an algorithm at the algorithmic level.
SoftExplorer is the first tool to estimate and characterize the power and energy of an algorithm from its source code.
SoftExplorer is a tool for estimating, characterizing and optimizing the power and energy of a processor from its C program.
The main takeaway from our work is that
power consumption can be optimized at the algorithmic level, and that it is possible to estimate the power consumption of a program from its source code.
the power and energy optimization at algorithmic level can be done in a systematic manner.
power and energy consumption can be estimated from the C program, and that this estimation is very precise.
